text: Create R/prep_<name>.R. file must start #' @include lists.R collate ordering. Use run_prep_step() consistent error handling: Key rules: - Use run_prep_step() — wraps try(), stores result state$<name>, emits cli::cli_warn() failure - Never use return() inside try() — extract helper function need early returns - state$exclude_path matters, pass file-listing functions - Always return state

text: Including preparation step optional can helpful several checks require preparations upfront. following example check two different fields present DESCRIPTION file, URL field BugReports field. checks can carried easily building preparation step desc package handling DESCRIPTION files. checks linked preparation via prep name: appears name argument make_prep(), preps argument make_check() finally name list extra_preps argument gp(). examples using custom checks can found rOpenSci unconf 2017 project checkers automated checking best practices research compendia.

title: goodpractice 1.1.00X (dev version)
text: Require R version >= 4.3, treesitter dependency (#302; thanks @christian-million) New use_skill_gp() learn_skill_gp() functions, plus bundled goodpractice4agents.md skill inst/skills/, giving AI agents instructions fix issues flagged goodpractice (#308, #312, #313; thanks @mpadge, @drmowinckels, @jonthegeek).

title: goodpractice 1.1.00X (dev version)
text: New GitHub issue templates bug reports feature requests complexity_unused_internal check longer flags standard R package hook functions (.onLoad, .onAttach, .onUnload, .onDetach, .Last.lib) unused (#319; thanks @TanguyBarthelemy). Fix urlchecker prep step pass fail = FALSE urlchecker::url_check(), restoring previous default behaviour upstream change (r-lib/urlchecker#42). .Rprofile now sources system-level ~/.Rprofile exists, rather entirely replacing . Fix test-integrity.R read .R source files (avoiding installed .rdb binaries) skip informatively none found. tidyverse_r_file_names: allow file names containing hyphens (-) require file extension .R (#307; thanks @JesseAlderliesten). Fix bug check group exclusions env vars, update vignette. Fix prep assignment check groups two checks (revdep + 1 tidyverse), including attaching “namespace” prep internally one full tidyverse prep stage run group. Fix bug printing check results produce error caused invalid marker types (#304; thanks @JesseAlderliesten). Convert remaining base warning() ts_parse() cli::cli_warn(), completing package-wide move cli messaging.

title: goodpractice 1.1
text: New all_check_groups() checks_by_group() functions discovering selecting checks category instead individual names (#239). Every check now belongs named group. Use all_check_groups() see 16 available groups checks_by_group("description") list checks group. Added new describe_check_groups() function, produce group descriptions console (#290). Added ‘groups’ param print() method, enable printing specified groups (#288). Exclude entire check groups via goodpractice.exclude_check_groups option GP_EXCLUDE_CHECK_GROUPS environment variable.

title: goodpractice 1.1
text: New default_checks() tidyverse_checks() helper functions. gp() now defaults default_checks() instead all_checks(), keeping optional check sets default run. New describe_check() function print descriptions implemented checks (@152) Exclude specific files checks via goodpractice.exclude_path option GP_EXCLUDE_PATH environment variable. Useful generated code like R/RcppExports.R.

title: goodpractice 1.1
text: goodpractice now uses cli, longer depends crayon clisymbols (@olivroy, #167). Check advice now uses cli inline markup throughout. gp strings support {.code}, {.fn}, {.pkg}, {.file}, {.field}, {.url} consistent styling. Custom checks can use markup gp strings. editor supports , goodpractice now prints clickable hyperlinks console. gp_advice() gains type parameter ("error", "info", "warning") control output symbol colour. Checks can return list(status = TRUE, type = "info") display informational messages without failure cross.

title: goodpractice 1.1
text: R code inspection now uses treesitter AST-based parsing instead regex getParseData(). Checks like print_return_invisible, tidyverse_no_missing, tidyverse_export_order benefit robust faster code analysis. Tree-sitter function detection now considers assignment operators (<-, =, <<-), avoiding false matches arithmetic expressions x + function() 1 (#277). ts_parse() now honours package’s declared Encoding reading source files, preventing mojibake packages using non-UTF-8 encodings. New duplicate_function_bodies check: flags functions identical bodies across files consolidated shared helper (#232).

title: goodpractice 1.1
text: Expanded default lintr checks 9 ~53, covering correctness (e.g. anyDuplicated() vs (duplicated())), performance (e.g. colSums() vs apply()), readability (e.g. switch() vs long /else chains), testthat best practices (e.g. expect_identical() vs expect_equal()). respect .lintr configuration files (#189). New lintr_installed_packages_linter check: flags calls installed.packages(), can slow rejected CRAN. Use find.package() system.file() instead (#278). New optional tidyverse style guide checks: 21 lintr-based checks plus 2 structural checks (R file naming, test file mirroring). Opt via checks = c(default_checks(), tidyverse_checks()).

title: goodpractice 1.1
text: prep_description defaults Encoding UTF-8 absent, downstream checks always concrete value. Unreadable files emit warning instead silently skipped (#277). description_not_start_with_package: Description start “package” description_urls_in_angle_brackets: URLs Description must wrapped angle brackets description_doi_format: DOIs use <doi:...> full URLs description_urls_not_http: URLs use https http no_description_duplicate_deps: duplicate packages across dependency fields description_valid_roles: Authors@R roles must valid MARC relator codes description_pkgname_single_quoted: Package names Title/Description must single-quoted

title: goodpractice 1.1
text: New r_file_extension check: flags R scripts using .r .q instead .R (#121). New print_return_invisible check: flags print methods don’t return invisible(x) (#49). New vignette_no_rm_list check: flags rm(list = ls()) vignettes (#20). New vignette_no_setwd check: flags setwd() vignettes (#21). New reverse_dependencies check: queries CRAN reverse dependencies advises running revdepcheck::revdep_check() submission. New spelling check: flags misspelled words documentation via spelling::spell_check_package() (#84). New has_readme has_news checks package documentation completeness (#45). New roxygen2 checks: export/noRd tagging, unknown tags, @inheritParams/@inheritDotParams validation (#197).

title: goodpractice 1.1
text: Added makefile (#203) Lowered default cyclomatic complexity limit 50 15, aligning lintr pkgcheck defaults. Configurable via goodpractice.cyclocomp_limit option (#150). Preparation steps can now run parallel via future.apply package. Set future::plan("multisession") calling gp() enable parallel data gathering (#47). gp() now fails path provided package (contain DESCRIPTION file) (#190, @maelle) Prep step error handling refactored run_prep_step() helper. New prep functions can use run_prep_step(state, "name", function() { ... }, quiet) instead manually wrapping work try() emitting warnings failure. Removed stringsAsFactors = FALSE arguments throughout, relying R 4.0 default. Package now requires R >= 4.0.0.
